name: Grumman F6F-5 Hellcat
blurb: The game's original Blender Hellcat, built from the cited F6F-5 dimensions with moving gear, propeller and control surfaces.
history:
The Grumman F6F Hellcat was designed to replace the F4F Wildcat and to counter the Mitsubishi A6M Zero, and it became the U.S. Navy's dominant fighter in the second half of the Pacific War. It used the Pratt & Whitney R-2800 Double Wasp, the engine of the Corsair and the P-47 Thunderbolt.

What this entry models: an original Blender model of the F6F-5 (span 42 ft 10 in, length 33 ft 7 in, 3-bladed propeller), with every figure the sources do not give labeled as an estimate in its script. It is the model used in flight; the retired download remains in the DEV Hangar.
